page.overview:
What is Dodinas Brandybuck?

Dodinas Brandybuck was a Hobbit of the Shire.

Dodinas was the fourth son of Gorbadoc Brandybuck and Mirabella Took. His siblings were Rorimac (who was the grandfather of Merry), Amaranth, Saradas, Asphodel, Dinodas, and Primula (who was the mother of Frodo Baggins).
